messages:
Priya: Heads up — found a weird auth/runtime mismatch when installing redwoodctl in silent mode on Windows. localserve ends up using a stale token from the wrong profile path and users see 401s.
Aria: Which installer/flags? MSI, winget, or the zip?
Priya: MSI v1.14.2, deployed via msiexec /i redwood-1.14.2.msi /qn with a config JSON for default profile. No interactive login step in the install.
Raul: That sounds like the install wrote credentials to %LOCALAPPDATA% but the CLI resolves %APPDATA% first (or vice versa). Windows path precedence can be messy.
Priya: Exact repro steps I used:
```
1) msiexec /i redwood-1.14.2.msi /qn CONFIG="{\"profile\":\"default\"}"
2) run redwoodctl localserve --port 8080 --profile default
3) observe auth failures in app logs: "401 Unauthorized: token expired" even though %APPDATA%\Redwood\profiles\default.json contains a valid token
```
Aria: Any installer logs? MSI verbose log would help (/l*v install.log).
Priya: I grabbed an MSI log and it shows credential file written to C:\Users\Me\AppData\Local\Redwood\profiles\default.json while the CLI checks C:\Users\Me\AppData\Roaming\Redwood\profiles\default.json.
Jen: Oof. So two locations in the wild. We need consistent precedence and a migration step for silent installs.
Raul: Quick question — is this only when the install runs as SYSTEM (like in SCCM) vs user context? That could cause write to Local vs Roaming.
Priya: Yep. Repro when deploy run under SYSTEM account (company push). When user later runs localserve, CLI resolves Roaming but file is in Local.
Jen: Proposed fix: installer should detect user context and write to the user's Roaming store if possible; additionally the CLI should fallback to check both locations and migrate on first run.
Raul: I'll open an issue + patch. Minimal CLI fallback patch: check LOCAL then ROAMING, and if found in LOCAL and ROAMING missing, copy it and log a one-time migration message.
CI Bot: Issue created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4121 — attached install.log and repro steps :white_check_mark:
Priya: Workaround for customers: run `redwoodctl auth migrate-paths --from local --to roaming --profile default` or run an interactive login once.
Aria: Can we add a telemetry event so we detect how often this happens in the wild?
Jen: Yes, add event `installer.credential_path_mismatch` and surface in console > onboarding alerts.
Priya: Thanks — can someone add the migration CLI and a changelog note for the next patch release? I can add the customer repro to the support ticket.
Raul: Assigning to @Raul for PR and @Jen for release note.
Jen: Adding to 1.14.3 milestone.
Priya: Thanks all, saved a long support thread.
